text:
Ottawa snapped Winnipeg's six-game winning streak with a 2-1 win on Tuesday, and Tyler Boucher scored in his NHL debut. Graeme Nichols of Coming Down the Pipe noted he joins Carter Yakemchuk as the only first-round picks in franchise history to score in their debut with Ottawa. It was the Senators' third straight win, and the chances backed all three: 59% of the expected goals (the quality of chances).

The scary moment of the month was Nick Cousins taking a big hit from Jakob Chychrun; DAZN reported he'd miss seven to 10 days. Michael Amadio's contract is another thread, with the Ottawa Citizen reporting he has tapped agent Andy Scott as extension talks loom.

The bigger picture is solid. The Senators are 14-6-2 with 30 points, about four more than our expected points, as a 52% team overall and 53% at five on five. Thomas Chabot and Jordan Spence have been the best pair by a distance, on for 17 goals for and 6 against. Travis Green has also found something in Claude Giroux, Amadio and Ridly Greig, a small sample (67 minutes) with 82% of the expected goals; NHL.com asked whether Greig is becoming a shutdown specialist. Our numbers give Ottawa 89% playoff odds. The thing to watch is whether the depth lines keep pace once Cousins is back.
